method.surface: Authenticated NYC Artist Coalition Facebook Page feed plus annual Meta Business Suite Published exports

terminalControl.reverifiedEndpointMarker: NYC Artist Coalition Recommendations to NYC Dept. of Cultural Affairs

method.reconciliation: The annual owner exports supplied 444 unique published-post IDs across every year in the surviving 2017-2021 chronology. Private platform identities reconciled the feed traversal; the public corpus retains only one-way hashes and excludes raw IDs, bodies, comments, and authenticated routes.
limitations: This accounts for 100% of the 444 rows in the annual Meta Business Suite Published exports for 2017-2021 and the terminal surviving Page-feed population; it is not proof that deleted, hidden, private, unpublished, or no-longer-retained posts never existed.
Meta reports export dates in Pacific Time while the feed can display another date context; year counts and private identity reconciliation, not exact day labels alone, control the crosswalk.
The shared Page identity does not identify the historical human author of each post.
Page-authored references to stakeholders are not incoming engagement, endorsement, formal partnership, mandate, or policy impact.
Export metrics are capture-date row values; summed reach is not unique people, attendance, conversion, endorsement, mandate, or impact.

populationReconciliation.boundary: The ledger accounts for all 444 rows exported by Meta's Published-post surface across every year in the surviving chronology. Deleted, hidden, private, unpublished, or no-longer-retained posts can remain outside both surfaces.

stakeholderSummary.boundary: Stakeholder tags describe account-level references, tags, routes, and issue interfaces. They do not establish that every named stakeholder engaged with, endorsed, or formally partnered with NYC Artist Coalition.

displayedInteractionSummary.boundary: The feed surface did not expose share labels consistently. Its reaction and comment displays are retained only as a separate volatile interface snapshot and must not be combined with native-export metrics. Neither surface establishes unique people, stakeholder identity, reach, attendance, conversion, endorsement, mandate, or impact.

ownerExportReconciliation.exportSurface: Meta Business Suite > Content > Published > annual export > Lifetime data view > Post content level > Creation date filter
ownerExportReconciliation.boundary: The annual CSV exports are protected research materials and are not committed. Their totals are row-level platform metrics captured on July 15, 2026. Summed post reach is not a unique-person audience total, and no metric identifies stakeholder groups.
